column1: # Source: OSRS Wiki shipwreck salvaging calculator (Module:Sandbox/User:Coopermor/ShipwreckSalvaging/Calc, via
# Flipping-Utilities/parsed-osrs data/modules, Oct 2026): bronze-hook success low/high out of 256 per shipwreck, the
# hook bonus in percent, rolls every 4 ticks (player) and 5 ticks (crew); crew low/high = player low/high x 10% per
# Deckhandiness, each rounded down; chance = (1 + floor(low (99 - L) / 98 + high (L - 1) / 98 + 0.5)) / 256.
